name: Paper Unfold Frames
summary: Photo-real stop-motion of a crumpled paper ball opening into a note, made from GPT-image keyframes.

distribution.label: Download skill ZIP
distribution.scope: One skill: SKILL.md, a frame keying script, two working prompts, a playback snippet and the licence. No media.

installation.title: Download the focused package
installation.body: Download the ZIP from the release and extract it. It holds only the skill folder; preview media and translations stay on separate branches of the repository.
installation.label: Release v1.0.1

installation.title: Add it to your agent
installation.body: Copy the extracted folder into your agent's skills directory (Claude Code: ~/.claude/skills/), or install it straight from main with git.

installation.title: Ask for an unfold
installation.body: Describe the shot in plain words, for example: "Open the video with a crumpled note that unfolds to show our tagline." The agent generates a 3x3 grid of stages, keys out the frames and plays them stepped at 6-8 fps.

manual_setup: Access to a GPT image model, for example through the Figma MCP generate_image tool or the OpenAI API.
Python 3 with Pillow, numpy and scipy to key out the frames.
A canvas-based video tool such as HyperFrames or Remotion, or a web page.
notes: Handwriting or a sketch can be baked into the image prompt so it is revealed as the sheet opens.
Sister skill: Paper Unfold Mesh draws the same effect procedurally in code.

image.alt: A 3x3 grid of paper stages from crumpled ball to flat torn sheet
